_comment: Independent public-input witness for win/tty/getline.c xwaitforspace() lines 244-248: Escape at a --More-- stores 1 in ttyDisplay->dismiss_more. A Caveman engraves with his fingers and escapes the "You write in the dust with your fingertip.--More--" and the text prompt after it. At the same --More-- on a second attempt ^P is refused and ^A (1) dismisses it, because nothing has cleared dismiss_more since; the text prompt is then answered.
